title: File:Cerro Oncol-lluvia.jpg
claims: A rain-and-fog view from Cerro Oncol: only the near shrub layer and a faint ridge are visible, with the upper slope swallowed by white cloud; no trail, flag or runner appears. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file Cerro Oncol-lluvia.jpg. The route page uses it as Cerro Oncol rain-and-fog context for the exposed and slippery section described by the organiser; it is not a photograph of the 2027 course or of race-day weather.

The Commons author field reads Lin linao; the file is marked CC-BY-SA-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/); the relevant date is 2007-11-11; the file page gives no camera coordinates; the original is 1,036 × 776 px; 249,384 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 719 px; 92,609 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits Lin linao, CC-BY-SA-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
